text.p: Unisys Corp said Thursday it opposes a recommendation from a large shareholder to separate its information services group and global customer services group businesses from its computer hardware and software group.
Greenway Partners LP, which issued a similar proposal last year, has suggested the two groups be separated through either a sale of the hardware/software business or a spin-off transaction.
Unisys said the separation of the computer systems group from the two services groups would jeopardize customer relationships dependent upon the combined capabilities of the three business units.

Greenway issued a similar proposal in March 1996, when it suggested that Unisys be split into three separate companies. That proposal was defeated by more than two-thirds at the company's annual meeting, Unisys said.
The company said that its goal in 1997 was for both year over year net income improvement quarter by quarter and full year profitability.
